title: Astra for Law leads in legal intelligence
headline: OpenAI releases updated Astra for Law model with expanded legal search index
summary: OpenAI has released an updated version of its Astra for Law model, which is built on the GPT-6.2 Astra frontier model. The update includes an expanded legal search index covering over 310 million URLs, including jurisdictions such as Australia, the UK, and Canada. The model is now available to ChatGPT Enterprise customers via the Trusted Access Program.
why_it_matters: The inclusion of Australian legal data in the model's search index and its performance on legal benchmarks highlight the increasing availability of domain-specific AI tools that require rigorous validation against hallucination risks in professional legal practice.

quotes.text: Since September, we’ve grown the index by 34%, adding over 80 million new URLs, including across international jurisdictions such as the UK, Australia, and Canada
Hallucinations are unacceptable in legal work. A single invented citation can cost a lawyer a client’s trust, credibility in court, and a reputation built over years.

classification.significance_reason: The update expands the model's jurisdictional coverage to include Australia, which is relevant for local legal practitioners assessing the tool's utility and risk profile.
